summary: Alight, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a 1-for-20 reverse stock split of all outstanding shares of Class A, B-1, B-2, and V common stock, effective June 30, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET, with post-split trading starting July 1, 2026. The split, approved by stockholders on June 10, 2026, aims to meet NYSE price criteria and pursue index inclusion like the Russell 3000. No consideration, premium, or advisor was named; authorized shares will decrease proportionally. The new CUSIP is 01626W200. This corporate action does not alter aggregate equity value. Watch for compliance with NYSE listing standards post-split.
